criteria.name: structure_program_delivered
criteria.description: a compilable settlement program sits at the declared path.

criteria.name: structure_records_delivered
criteria.description: all eleven records of the shipped season are delivered under /app/out and parse as non-empty JSON.

criteria.name: structure_program_takes_directories
criteria.description: the program writes its records into the directory it is given, and into /app/out from /app/data when given none.

criteria.name: structure_canonical_serialisation
criteria.description: every delivered record is written in the form record_shapes.md states.

criteria.name: structure_findings_canonical_form
criteria.description: the finding record of a reseeded season is ordered, holds each pair once, uses known codes and tallies them.

criteria.name: closure_mix_settlement
criteria.description: on a season where a forge is refused by both the cap and the floor, a retired pair of reagents meets the cap, and a salvage sits on the same-day window boundary, the season summary, the vault audit and the per-patch reconciliation all match the settled season.

criteria.name: closure_mix_findings_and_workshops
criteria.description: on a season where a forge is refused by both the cap and the floor, a retired pair of reagents meets the cap, and a salvage sits on the same-day window boundary, the finding record and every workshop report match the settled season.

criteria.name: closure_mix_guilds_and_allocation
criteria.description: on a season where a forge is refused by both the cap and the floor, a retired pair of reagents meets the cap, and a salvage sits on the same-day window boundary, every guild report and the requisition allocation match the settled season.

criteria.name: cap_boundary_workshop_figures

criteria.name: merge_chain_smith_rows

criteria.name: quiet_rules_findings

criteria.name: negative_hardcoded_sample_answers
criteria.description: the program replays this season's answers on a different corpus.

criteria.name: negative_filename_dependent_behaviour
criteria.description: the program settles the same corpus differently under another name.

criteria.name: negative_nondeterministic_output
criteria.description: two runs over one corpus disagree.

criteria.name: negative_reads_training_corpus_at_runtime
criteria.description: pointed at another corpus, the program still reads the shipped season under /app/data.

criteria.name: negative_rebinds_verifier_dependencies
criteria.description: running the program plants a module or path hook where the grader would import it.

criteria.name: negative_imports_outside_standard_library
criteria.description: the delivered program imports a module from outside the Python standard library.
